question: In reptiles, the sex of the offsprings is determined by the temperature at which:
solution:
The correct answer is **__Fertilised egg is kept__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Every species are classified into five kingdom -**Monera, Protista, Fungi, Plantae and Animalia**** by R.H. Whittaker.__**
 
• Animalia is classified into **Chordata and non chordata.**

__
 
• **Chordates** are animals characterized by the presence of **notochord** at some stage during their development. Members possess a **hollow** **nerve** **cord** and **pharyngeal** **gill** **slits**
 
• **Non Chordates: **lack of backbone .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Reptiles: **This is chordate animal. Their skin is dry, and rough, without **any** **glands. **The body is divided into head, neck, trunk, and tail.
 
• **Porifera, Cyonopera, Platyhelminthes, Aschelminthes, Cyonophera, Annelida, Mollusca, Echinodermata, Hemichordata, and Arthropods **are examples of **non**-**chordates** found in the phylum.
 
• **fishes**, **amphibians**, **reptiles**, **birds**, and **mammals** are example of chordates.
 
• **Arthopoda **is the largest phylum among all phylum.
